title: Affine-local quasi-coherence of higher direct images
statement: For a quasi-compact separated morphism and quasi-coherent module, every affine open U of the base has quasi-coherent restriction of the q-th higher direct image.

proof.text: Restrict to an affine open of the base, identify the higher direct image with the ordinary right-derived module direct image, and apply the ordinary quasi-coherence theorem.
